answer: The nebula report reveals the merge explicitly at each echo. Each collapsed cluster gets one willow weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 246 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 222 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1931 identities would post 4504 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
